what: Source of every first-hand figure on the ICT hub page after the two parallel updates were merged, and the outcome of comparing each figure with its source file.
method: Results table and map table, both languages: each cell compared with the result file or research summary.
Running text: the source value must round to the printed figure, and the figure must occur in both versions.
Derived statements (counts such as 'eight of the ten'): recomputed from the same source values.
en against zh-hant: every date, clock time and number tokenised with research/compare_numbers_en_zh.py.
notes: The comparison was run by a one-off script that is not in the repository; each entry names the file and the place in it, so any line can be redone by hand.

research/ict-trading/ict-trading_status.json and ict-trading_status.py date from the first version of the page and still list two backtested concepts. Their counts (swing points, gaps, sweeps, stop distances) are still the source of the figures quoted from them; their status list is superseded by status_of_the_twelve below.
Figures quoted from outside sources (clock windows, 40 ticks, 15 pips, 30 to 90 minutes) are not in this file.
The busiest three-hour block (09:00 to 12:00) and the regrouping of trades by entry hour were both made after the first run of the kill zones script; the page says so.
